episodes.title: What is an Animal?
episodes.description: Explore what makes an organism an animal and why drawing that boundary is more complicated than it first appears.

episodes.title: What's the Most "Animal" Animal?
episodes.description: Compare familiar animals with the wider animal kingdom and reconsider which creatures best represent animal life.

episodes.title: Diversity of Bodies & Sizes (but mostly crabs)
episodes.description: Compare animal growth, body plans, and skeletons, including the evolutionary similarities behind very different-looking animals.

episodes.title: How & What Animals Eat
episodes.description: Explore how animal diets shape bodies and habitats, from carnivores and herbivores to organisms with unusual food sources.

episodes.title: Brainy & Brainless Animals
episodes.description: Compare animal nervous systems and discover why a small, simple brain can sometimes be more useful than a complex one.

episodes.title: How Animals See
episodes.description: One of the most common adaptations seen in the animal kingdom is vision.

episodes.title: How Animals Hear
episodes.description: Explore how animals detect sound and use vibrations to understand their surroundings.

episodes.title: Ancestral & Weird Senses
episodes.description: Investigate smell, taste, and animals’ abilities to detect electric and magnetic fields.

episodes.title: Reproduction
episodes.description: Look beyond animal offspring to the genes and reproductive processes behind the next generation.

episodes.title: Animals Working Together
episodes.description: Compare complex animal social relationships and cooperative behavior with human interactions.

episodes.title: Parasites
episodes.description: Nearly every environment on Earth — and that includes animals — is home to some kind of parasite.

episodes.title: Phylogenetic Mysteries
episodes.description: Use evolutionary relationships to investigate puzzles in animal classification.

episodes.title: What is a Species?
episodes.description: Examine competing ways scientists define species and why animal diversity makes classification difficult.

episodes.title: Frontiers in Zoology
episodes.description: Explore opportunities to participate in zoology and help study animal life.
